name: What factors influence the cost of bathroom vanity installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of bathroom vanity installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost of bathroom vanity installation depends primarily on cabinet size, countertop material, and whether plumbing lines or wall finishes need modification. A basic pre-assembled single-sink vanity swap with compatible plumbing is straightforward and keeps labor minimal. Costs increase if you switch from a single to a double vanity, install a heavy marble or quartz top, or require sub-trade coordination for electrical outlet additions and plumbing re-routes. Additional carpentry, such as repairing water-damaged drywall, installing tile backsplashes, or custom molding, also shapes the overall project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on vanity size, countertop material, plumbing changes, and whether drywall repairs, trim carpentry, or tile backsplashes are required.
